title: Cawden Vale blanket-makers expand dyehouse
text: Halberd Mills Cooperative has opened a second dyehouse at its Cawden Vale site. The cooperative, which makes wool blankets, says demand has outstripped its single dye vat for three seasons running. It employs no weavers directly, since every member works to their own hours, and it has held the Fenmoor design award since 2015.
